title: 2206. Divide Array Into Equal Pairs

examples.explanation: There are 6 elements in nums, so they should be divided into 6 / 2 = 3 pairs. If nums is divided into the pairs (2, 2), (3, 3), and (2, 2), it will satisfy all the conditions.
There is no way to divide nums into 4 / 2 = 2 pairs such that the pairs satisfy every condition.
